comment: Top-level site-packages entries NOT shipped in Wisp's bundled engine. Wisp uses oMLX for text generation, tool calling, embeddings and rerank; none of the features below. A feature whose package is absent fails only when that route is used. Static import analysis cannot prune further (the transitive closure from omlx reaches ~everything), so this list is a reviewed denylist and must be re-validated by scripts/engine_smoke.py after every engine update.

drop.onnxruntime: file-type detection and document conversion (magika/markitdown), 82 MB
drop.llvmlite: numba JIT backend, audio feature extraction only, 131 MB
drop.numba: audio feature extraction only (imported lazily by librosa), 30 MB
drop.phonemizer: text-to-speech only; GPL/LGPL components not needed by Wisp (phonemizer and espeak-ng are GPL)
drop.phonemizer_fork: text-to-speech only; GPL/LGPL components not needed by Wisp (phonemizer and espeak-ng are GPL)
drop.espeakng_loader: text-to-speech only; GPL/LGPL components not needed by Wisp (phonemizer and espeak-ng are GPL)
drop.misaki: text-to-speech only; GPL/LGPL components not needed by Wisp (phonemizer and espeak-ng are GPL)
drop.num2words: text-to-speech only; GPL/LGPL components not needed by Wisp (phonemizer and espeak-ng are GPL)

candidates_not_applied.scipy: 101 MB; needed by audio libraries, possibly lazily by vision processors. Prune only after a vision-model smoke test.
candidates_not_applied.transformers: 107 MB; required by tokenizers and chat templates, cannot be dropped
